quest.title: The Great Tree: Rooted State
quest.description: Yasmin seems to be up to something...

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Traveler! Thank goodness you're here. I was just in need of someone's help!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything wrong with the Divine Tree's roots?

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Oh, the Divine Tree is perfectly fine.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: And my job here is to keep it that way.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: To be specific, I am sprinkling these potions around the tree's roots.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, I can't move all these potions on my own, while Ladep and Pharez are busily engaged in their own work.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: As such, I could really use your help in moving these potions.

choices.text: Ladep and Pharez? Who are they, again?

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: Oh, they are students, just like me. But Ladep is from Spantamad, and Pharez is from Kshahrewar.

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: We are researching on a shared topic, thus the cooperation despite our different ideologies.

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: These potions, for example, are the fruits of our teamwork.

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: Okay, I will carry this one, and I'll be counting on you for the rest. Thank you!

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: Careful now. Ladep said the potions were intentionally made with a foul odor so that no one would drink them by accident.

response.speaker: Yasmin
response.text: Try not to get any on your clothes... The smell won't wash off easily at all.

dialogues.speaker: Panicked Students
dialogues.text: Yasmin! Wah!

dialogues.speaker: Panicked Students
dialogues.text: I—I can't breathe! I've gotta get out of here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is this... *cough* *cough*! This smell...

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Well, it seems that Ladep has done well.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: We're done with the sprinkling here. Let's move to the next spot. It's not far away.

dialogues.speaker: Awan
dialogues.text: Yasmin? What are you doing here? Ugh... Are you here to sprinkle your potion again?

dialogues.speaker: Awan
dialogues.text: Those roots look perfectly fine. No more potions are needed here.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Even so, we should take good care of them.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Crossing the bridge only when we get to it is like getting a Fish Roll ready, only to realize that the fish is undercooked.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: At that point, your options are either to start all over again or to open up the already rolled pastry, both of which are a pain in the neck.

dialogues.speaker: Awan
dialogues.text: Okay, okay, I can't beat you in an argument... But I have talked to you about the smell of that potion, right?

dialogues.speaker: Awan
dialogues.text: I live nearby, and I don't want to sleep with that funky smell in my nostrils, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I already had Ladep adjust the formula. The odor shouldn't be too offensive.

dialogues.speaker: Awan
dialogues.text: Fine then, I'm leaving. Don't come sprinkling that potion of yours near my yard. I can't take it...

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Alright, I get it. Traveler, could you pass me the potions in that case?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You administer the potions with Yasmin...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The potions really do smell terrible...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But it seems that you're not bothered by it at all, Yasmin...

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: If you mean the smell... My nose has whiffed many things far worse than that.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Alright, that should be all we need. I have also gathered some data. I'm sure Pharez will be thrilled...

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: Here is your payment, Traveler. Thank you for your help so far.

dialogues.speaker: Yasmin
dialogues.text: I wonder how Ladep and Pharez are doing with their work...

dialogues.speaker: Playful Student
dialogues.text: (I should be able to return a little later today...)

dialogues.speaker: Panicked Student
dialogues.text: (Eek! Not again!?)
